name: Product Sync for WooCommerce
author: Misha Rudrastyh

sections.description:
The Product Sync for WooCommerce plugin allows you to connect multiple WooCommerce stores and sync products between them. This is the free version of the plugin, which means that it comes with some limitations, however, it will be perfect for some basic synchronization scenarios.

Compare Free vs. Pro | 🚀 Get Pro

Features

✅ Instant product sync
Select a checkbox for a specific connected store when editing a product, and the product will instantly be published or updated on that connected store.

✅ Choose product data to sync
The plugin allows you to decide which product data to sync to connected WooCommerce stores. For example, you can exclude prices or product statuses from the sync.

✅ Two-directional product sync
Install the plugin on “Store A” and connect “Store B”, and also install the plugin on “Store B” and connect “Store A” – that’s all you need to do for both-way synchronisation.

✅ Synhronize product deletion
The plugin also allows you to automatically delete synced products when the original product is deleted.

✅ Debug logging
All the syncing information is available in “WooCommerce > Status > Logs”.

Pro features

⚡️ Unlimited stores
An unlimited number of WooCommerce stores can be connected (only one in the free version of the plugin).

⚡️ Auto Mode
The Auto Mode allows you to sync products to all connected stores automatically (without selecting them with checkboxes).

⚡️ Custom fields
Product metadata (custom fields) synchronization (you can also exclude specific meta keys from syncing in the plugin settings).

⚡️ Dynamically change product data
Change product prices (or other product data) dynamically when syncing to a specific store.

⚡️ Syncing products without SKU
By default, the Pro version of the plugin connects synced products by a meta field (and variations by their attributes), which allows you to sync products and variations without SKUs. But you can switch to the SKU connection in the plugin settings as well.

⚡️ Bulk sync products
You can select multiple products from the “Products > All Products” page and sync them to the selected WooCommerce store at once.

⚡️ WP-CLI
The plugin allows you to manage the product synchronization process with WP-CLI commands.

⚡️ ACF, Elementor, WPML, etc.
Integrations with all popular WordPress plugins and themes are available in the Pro version of the plugin.

🚀 Upgrade to Pro

Did you know?

Though the Product Sync for WooCommerce plugin allows you to sync product stock information as well, it only happens when you update a product manually via the WordPress administration area. If you need a complete inventory sync solution, take a look at the Inventory Sync for WooCommerce plugin. Needless to say, these two plugins have perfect compatibility with each other.

Need Help?

If you are faced with any type of issue while using the product sync plugin or if you have an improvement suggestion, please visit the support forum, and I will help you ASAP.
sections.installation:
Automatic Install

  1. Log into your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Product Sync for WooCommerce”
  3. Click “Install Now” under the Product Sync for WooCommerce plugin
  4. Click “Activate Now”

Manual Install

  1. Download the plugin from the download button on this page
  2. Unzip the file, and upload the resulting rudrastyh-product-sync-for-woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins directory
  3. Log into your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins
  4. Click “Activate” under the Product Sync for WooCommerce plugin
sections.faq:
Does it work on localhost?

Yes, but if you are going to sync from localhost to a remote server, products with images will not be synced. It is not supported by default by the WooCommerce REST API. But you can consider using the PRO version of the plugin where it is fully supported.

Does it support two-way product sync?

Yes. But in this case you need to install the plugin on both sites and add each one in the plugin settings.

Does it work with the Image and Gallery custom fields in ACF?

Yes, but this feature is only available in the Pro version of the plugin.
sections.changelog:
2.0

  • Added: The plugin now can sync products between stores within the same WordPress Multisite network

1.5

  • Added: Product brands added to a product can now be synced along with categories and tags (product brands with the same slugs must exist on target stores)
  • Fixed: An issue with duplicated variations when updating already synced variable products
  • Fixed: An issue with syncing images when Product image is excluded from syncing in the plugin settings
  • Fixed: An issue when a synced product is not deleted from the target store even though the “Product deletion” checkbox is checked in the plugin settings

1.4

  • Added: Compatibility with the Order Sync for WooCommerce plugin

1.3

  • Added: Product creation and modified dates are now fully supported
  • Fixed: An issue when excluded fields settings were not applied
  • UI improvements for the latest WordPress and WooCommerce versions

1.2.1

  • Minor bug fixes

1.2

  • Improved plugin logging (logs are available in WooCommerce > Status > Logs)
  • Added: Translation support for log messages
  • Minor UI improvements

1.1

  • Added: Synced products are now connected by SKU
  • Fixed: An issue when syncing product data changes happened only on the second product update

1.0

  • Initial release
